name: jrbedard/3d-converter
description: Fast C++ command-line 3D file format converter supporting OBJ, 3DS, MA, MB, XSI, LWO, DXF, STL, and DAE formats.
score_rationale: Lightweight format converter with 179 stars covering legacy formats, but appears unmaintained and lacks support for modern formats like glTF or USD.
summary: Command-line converter for legacy 3D formats (OBJ, DAE, STL, LWO)
